Dear ImGui is vendored from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui at v1.91.9b,
commit f5befd2d29e66809cd1110a152e375a7f1981f06. Core, Win32 backend,
DX12 backend, and reference example all come from this revision, unmodified.
See imgui/LICENSE.txt (MIT). No network access is required to configure/build.
Reference: imgui/examples/example_win32_directx12/main.cpp.
